was: Privately managed year-round RV park on US-65 S in Harrison (gateway to Buffalo National River). Gravel full-hookup sites (electric/water/sewer/cable, 30/50 amp), big-rig pull-thrus, pool, laundry, game room. Reservable online via Campspot. --Claude
note: Private RV park on US 65 south of Harrison, a gateway to the Buffalo National River, with gravel sites, cable TV, a pool and a game room. --Claude

was: Privately owned year-round campground on Hwy 206E near Harrison; 40 sites (24 full-hookup, 7 electric, 9 electric/water), 30/50 amp, plus cabins and tent sites. Accommodates RVs up to ~45 ft. Reservable online via Campspot. --Claude
note: Private campground on Highway 206 east of Harrison, with cabins and tent sites: 24 full-hookup sites, 9 with water and electric and 7 with electric only. --Claude

was: Privately owned RV park at 597 Whitney Lane, Kensett (formerly Whitney Lane RV, new ownership, expanding). Full-hookup pull-thru and back-in sites, level gravel pads, 30/50 amp, concrete patios, accommodates rigs up to 50 ft. Laundry, WiFi, pavilions. Reservable online via Campspot. --Claude
note: Private RV park in Kensett, just outside Searcy, formerly Whitney Lane RV, with level gravel sites, concrete patios and pavilions. --Claude

was: Privately owned RV park and general store at Mt Olive (near Melbourne), 4710 Mt Olive Rd. 12 back-in full-hookup sites, 30/50 amp, level gravel partially-shaded pads; tent sites, cabin, on-site store, laundry, showers. Near a White River trout access. Reservable via Campspot. --Claude
note: Private RV park and general store at Mt. Olive, near Melbourne and a White River trout access, with level, partly shaded gravel sites, tent sites and a cabin. --Claude

was: Privately owned in-town RV park at 320 Oak Ave, Mountain View, a 4-min walk to the downtown Court Square music/dining district. Level graveled full-service sites, 30/50 amp, cable TV, WiFi, laundry, hot showers; cabin rental; on-site 90-seat theatre hosting open music jams. Nightly bookable (Campspot/RoverPass). --Claude
note: Private RV park in Mountain View, a few minutes' walk from the music and restaurants around the Court Square, with level gravel sites, cable TV, a rental cabin and a 90-seat theater that hosts open music jams. --Claude

note: Private RV park and guest motel on North Bayou Drive in Mountain View, a few minutes from the town square and the Ozark Folk Center, with concrete and gravel pads and a bathhouse. --Claude

note: Family-owned RV park off Highway 412 near Springdale, with a pool, a playground, a game room, tent sites and cabins. --Claude

note: Private RV park at Vilonia on the grounds of a decommissioned Titan II missile complex, which also has an event center and a bed and breakfast, with gravel sites for big rigs and tent sites. --Claude

was: City of Worthington municipal campground on Lake Okabena; 63 electric spur sites, central water, dump, bathhouses, boat landing, lake/bike trail, dog park. Open Apr 1-Oct 31. Reservable via Campspot. --Claude
note: City of Worthington campground in Olson Park, near Lake Okabena, with bathhouses, a boat landing, the trail around the lake and a dog park: 58 sites with electric and 5 primitive ones, with water from central taps. --Claude

was: City of Silver Bay municipal campground on Lake Superior's North Shore; 49 sites (34 full-hookup 20/30/50A, 15 electric-only), pull-throughs, RVs to ~75 ft. Reservable online (Campspot). Open ~mid-May to mid-Oct. --Claude
note: City of Silver Bay campground on Lake Superior's North Shore, beside Black Beach Park, with an ATV trail from the campground.  It opened in 2020, so the trees are still young and shade is thin.  34 sites have full hookups and 15 electric only; the electric-only sites take rigs up to 35 feet.  The nearest boat launch is at the Silver Bay Marina, about 5 miles south. --Claude

was: Itasca County Land Department campground (Fairgrounds Park) in Grand Rapids. After a 2023 renovation nearly 40 sites have electric/water/sewer (20/30/50-amp), plus 10 rustic and 6 grass-electric sites; wash house with showers/laundry, dump station. Reservable via Campspot, May-Sept; adjacent racetrack races Thu/Sat. --Claude
note: Itasca County Land Department campground at the fairgrounds in Grand Rapids, among tall red and white pines, renovated in 2023, with a wash house: nearly 40 full-hookup sites, 6 grassy sites with electric and 10 rustic ones.  The fairgrounds' Trailhead Building is the information center for the Mesabi bike trail. --Claude
